description: This file defines Kubernetes API types related to EndpointSlice, including the EndpointSlice struct, Endpoint, EndpointConditions, EndpointHints, and related types, used for representing subsets of service endpoints.

classes.name: EndpointSlice
classes.description: Represents a subset of the endpoints that implement a service, including metadata, address type, endpoints, and ports.

classes.name: Endpoint
classes.description: Represents a single logical backend endpoint with addresses, conditions, hostname, target reference, topology, and hints.

classes.name: EndpointConditions
classes.description: Contains current status conditions of an endpoint such as readiness, serving, and terminating.

classes.name: EndpointHints
classes.description: Provides hints on how an endpoint should be consumed, including zone and node information.

classes.name: ForZone
classes.description: Indicates the zone(s) an endpoint should be consumed by.

classes.name: ForNode
classes.description: Indicates the node(s) an endpoint should be consumed by.

classes.name: EndpointPort
classes.description: Represents a network port used by an EndpointSlice, including name, protocol, port number, and application protocol.
